title: KA59 level-boundary preservation gate

supported_facts: The model's click/teleport working theory was wrong.
The wrong Level 1 theory hardened into an unsuccessful Level 2 strategy.

supported_preservation_requires: source-level relation support independent of reward alone
new_level_procedure: carry source relation as PREDICTED_PRESERVED when destination preservation is not yet witnessed
rank low-cost actions by candidate-pair separation
only then allow surviving relations to dominate planning
next_test: Run the gate and selector on a replay level boundary with explicit early competing correspondences.
